chunk: description: Canonical model for outbound shipment records — covers shipping order creation, carrier assignment, label generation, and tracking. Used between ERP and shipping platforms (ShipStation, EasyPost, etc.).
createdFrom: homage engagement (2026-05-19) — NetSuite ↔ ShipStation integration (UC12-potential — Turbine replacement)
note: "Stub — created from homage engagement. Promoted to versioned schema when confirmed fields from 2+ clients."

properties:
  shipmentId:
    type: string
    description: Canonical shipment identifier
  externalShipmentId:
    type: string
    description: Source-system shipment ID (e.g. ShipStation order ID or NetSuite fulfillment internalId)
  orderId:
    type: string
    description: Canonical order identifier
  externalOrderId:
    type: string
    description: Source-system order ID
  status:
    type: string
    enum: [pending, awaiting_pickup, shipped, delivered, exception, cancelled]
  shipTo:
    type: object
    properties:
      name:
        type: string
      addressLine1:
        type: string
      addressLine2:
        type: string
      city:
        type: string
      state:
        type: string
      postalCode:
        type: string
      country:
        type: string
      phone:
        type: string
  lineItems:
    type: array
    items:
      type: object
      properties:
        sku:
          type: string
        quantity:
          type: integer
        weight:
          type: number
        weightUnit:
          type: string
  weight:
    type: number
    description: Total shipment weight
  weightUnit:
    type: string
    enum: [lb, kg, oz, g]
  dimensions:
    type: object
    properties:
      length:
        type: number
      width:
        type: number
      height:
        type: number
      unit:
        type: string
  carrier:
    type: string
    description: Carrier name (UPS, FedEx, USPS, EasyPost, Amazon Shipping)
  serviceCode:
    type: stri
